init.title: Set up work area
init.imperative: Run: python <commander-skill-dir>/scripts/init_work_area.py <work-id>. Start the work branch per repo guidance.

context.title: Load baseline context
context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, docs/agents/engine-config.json. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context, glossary, engine config loaded

understand.title: Understand the ask
understand.imperative: In your own context (the interrogator must reach the human), load constellation-interrogator and drive interrogation.json with the request, context, and commander starting questions; save the consolidated problem statement. Confirm it with the human.

postconditions.statement: problem statement and protected intent confirmed

plan.title: Author the gate plan
plan.imperative: Frame the bounded problem against the architecture packets. Author the gate plan into execute.json: each gate the smallest reasonable bite, with close criteria and required evidence. Get the human to approve it.

compact.title: Compact context and reload skills
compact.imperative: Run /compact to compress conversation context. Then reload the constellation-commander skill into this context and load the constellation-pilot skill into this context. Both must be active and confirmed before proceeding to execute.

postconditions.statement: commander and pilot skills loaded in this context

execute.title: Execute the plan
execute.imperative: Using the pilot skill already loaded in this context, drive execute.json gate by gate in this conversation. Do not dispatch a subagent. If a gate proves the plan wrong, surface the decision to the user before continuing.

postconditions.statement: every gate closed with integrated evidence

reconcile.title: Reconcile the map
reconcile.imperative: Hand the implemented changes to a subagent that invokes constellation-cartographer to fold them into the recorded architecture.

triage.title: Route future work
triage.imperative: Load the constellation-triage skill into this context. Drive triage on execute.json triage_candidates in this conversation — do not dispatch a subagent. Before creating any issues, present the full list of recommendations to the human and get explicit approval for each issue to be filed.

postconditions.statement: every triage candidate routed or recorded

review.title: Review accomplishments with user
review.imperative: Summarize all gates closed, changes implemented, architecture changes reconciled, and triage items routed or filed. Present the full run summary to the user. Get their confirmation before archiving.

archive.title: Archive, commit, and push
archive.imperative: Commit all remaining work. Push the branch to remote. Move .agent-work/<work-id>/ to .agent-work/archive/<date>-<work-id>/. Confirm the branch is clean and merge-ready per repo guidance.
